evals.name: deal-highlights-eval-1-mixed-call
evals.expected_output: A short bulleted list (5-10 items) covering the price objection, the firm $140,000 budget number, the RouteWise competitive mention, the October/mid-September timeline pressure, and Sam's Friday revised-proposal commitment — each with its quote. The conference/flight small talk and the 'did you catch the game' exchange do not appear as highlights. Closes with a one-line summary of why this call matters.
expectations: Includes the price objection, citing Alex's line that the quote came in almost 30% above budget
Includes the $140,000 budget number, citing Alex's 'Finance capped us at $140,000... that's firm' line
Includes the RouteWise competitive mention, citing Alex naming them as a competitor being evaluated
Includes Sam's commitment to send a revised proposal by Friday, citing that line directly
Does NOT list the Denver conference / flight delay small talk as a highlight
Does NOT list the 'did you catch the game last night' exchange as a highlight
Every listed highlight carries a direct quote or timestamp — no highlight appears without one
Ends with a one-line 'why this call matters' summary a manager could read alone

evals.name: deal-highlights-eval-2-thin-call
evals.prompt: run deal-highlights on a transcript that is almost entirely small talk and scheduling logistics, with no real commitment, objection, buying signal, competitive mention, risk, or number
evals.expected_output: A very short list (2-3 items or fewer) or an explicit statement that the call had little worth flagging, rather than padding out small talk into invented highlights.
expectations: Does not pad the list to 5-10 items when the call doesn't support that many real highlights
Does not present small talk or scheduling logistics as a highlight just to fill space
